inputs: VBAT_PROTECTED (logical two-wire battery interface; actual mating polarity pending)
interfaces.no_connects: A null net means intentional NC on a reviewed component. On a blocked component, null means unresolved and no CAD connection is permitted.

blockers: J102 is a logical two-wire battery interface, not an approved mating pinout. Select an ordinary protected 1S 4.2 V LiPo pack and verify its connector rating and polarity before assigning the footprint. J104 is an optional unpopulated separate cell-contact thermistor interface.
Charging is hard disabled by fitted R120. J104 is DNP. Fitting a thermistor alone does not enable or qualify charging; an independently reviewed autonomous temperature window is still required.
L101 exact MPN and footprint are not selected. Verify effective inductance, saturation current and DCR.

The single nominal 3.3 V rail can fall below the exact WS2812C-V6 3.3 V source lower limit even statically. User-approved first-prototype exception only: LED startup, color, brightness, data and transient operation are not guaranteed. Measure shared-rail behavior under combined loads before any release.

The two-wire battery pack and connector are not selected. Their ratings must cover measured peak loads, or firmware and hardware limits must constrain those loads. The prior 1 A candidate cannot support unqualified simultaneous maxima.
USB100 mode limits charger input, not total USB load. USB enumeration, suspend, current advertisement, inrush and upstream fault coordination remain unqualified.

prototype_exceptions.decision: User explicitly approved trying one nominal 3.3 V shared regulator rail on 2026-11-09.
prototype_exceptions.limit: Exact WS2812C-2020-V6 source lower supply limit is 3.3 V; calculated static PWM rail may reach 3.2559 V before PFM, wiring and transient effects.
prototype_exceptions.acceptance: Bench validation required; do not claim guaranteed LED operation. Revisit rail architecture if tests fail.
